Rhyperior: Huge HP and Defence with Solid Rock cutting super-effective hits. Hard Stone Stone Edge and Headlong Rush hit hard, and it walls the Fire teams that dominate Valor Mountain.
Golisopod (Aevian Form): Your win condition. Skill Link turns Bone Rush and Pin Missile into five-hit attacks that break Sashes and Sturdy, and one Swords Dance lets it one-shot almost every boss mon.
Azumarill: Huge Power doubles its Attack, so Aqua Tail and Play Rough hit like a legendary's. Bulky Water/Fairy typing with a Dragon immunity; only 3 remaining boss mons can one-shot it.
Annihilape: Fast Fighting/Ghost with Defiant. Rage Fist gains 50 power every time it's hit, so it turns the hits it takes into one-shots; Close Combat and Sucker Punch round it out. Normal and Fighting moves can't touch it.
Donphan: Sturdy plus a huge physical attack stat: High Horsepower and Head Smash hit almost anything. Strong alone, but it overlaps Rhyperior and Golisopod on Ground, so it stays benched.
Passimian: Defiant Fighting type with Close Combat; punishes Intimidate leads and hits Rock, Steel, Dark and Normal hard. Solid, simple attacker.
Mudsdale: Very bulky Ground type with strong High Horsepower and Superpower. Takes hits well and slows foes with Rock Tomb.
Whiscash: Its crest removes every weakness and boosts Atk/SpA, so it can switch into almost anything. Earthquake and Aqua Tail on a nearly unkillable body; the glue of the weakness rule.
Feraligatr: Sheer Force boosts Crunch and Ice Fang with no drawback. One Agility makes it faster than every boss mon, so it can sweep.
Hariyama: Massive HP, Thick Fat halves Fire and Ice, and Fake Out gives free turns in doubles. Close Combat and Heavy Slam hit hard.
Gastrodon: Storm Drain makes it immune to Water and redirects those moves in doubles. Recover and Earth Power make it a sturdy special tank.
Lunatone (Lunatone Dominant Fusion): Lunar Idol gives Levitate and boosts Ice moves. Psychic plus Icy Wind give it damage and speed control; Focus Sash keeps it alive.
Throh: Guts tank that unlocks Storm Throw (always crits), Bulk Up and Wide Guard with the relearner: a doubles bodyguard that grows.
Slowbro: Very high Defence and HP with Psychic and Surf. Soaks physical hits and chips the whole field with spread Surf in doubles.
Arcanine: Intimidate on entry and Extreme Speed priority, plus Flare Blitz from the relearner for real Fire damage.
Crabominable: Iron Fist Ice Hammer and Close Combat hit very hard. Fighting/Ice coverage beats Dragons, fliers and Steel.
Golem: Sturdy guarantees it survives one hit; Stone Edge and Earthquake are strong. Can set Stealth Rock before going down.
Musharna (Aevian Form): Tough Claws boosts contact moves like Play Rough and Throat Chop. Dark/Fairy is a great defensive pair, and it can set Trick Room once that TM arrives.
Gholdengo: Good as Gold blocks every status move. Steel/Ghost resists Flying, Psychic, Fairy and Dragon and is immune to Normal, Fighting and Poison; Make It Rain hits both foes.
Glalie (Aevian Form): With Grassy Surge (Ability Capsule) and the relearner's Grassy Glide, it hits first every turn in its own terrain and heals each turn. Rock Slide adds spread damage.
Solrock (Solrock Dominant Fusion): Solar Idol fusion. Stone Edge plus Flare Blitz (relearner) cover a lot, and it pairs with Lunatone.
Jellicent: Water Spout at full HP is a massive spread hit, and Cursed Body disables attackers. Water/Ghost resists a lot.
Lapras (Aevian Form): No Guard means Sing and Rock Slide never miss. Dragon Dance plus Rock Slide can sweep doubles.
Camerupt: With the relearner, Eruption at full HP is a 150-power spread move, and Solid Rock makes it bulky. A true doubles nuke once it's Modest.
Pangoro: Scrappy lets its Fighting moves hit Ghosts. Strong but slow Fighting/Dark attacker.
Dragalge: Adaptability boosts Dragon Pulse and Sludge Bomb to big numbers. Good special attacker against Fairies and Dragons.
Unfezant (Aevian Form Male): Sturdy Rock/Fighting with Head Smash. Hits hard once, survives one hit, but frail otherwise.
Cetitan: Sheer Force Icicle Crash and Belly Drum potential. Huge HP; slow but powerful Ice attacker.
Crawdaunt: Adaptability Crabhammer and Crunch hit very hard, and Dragon Dance makes it fast. Fragile, so it needs support.
Reuniclus: Magic Guard blocks all chip damage, and Recover keeps it around. Strong Psychic special attacker for Trick Room later.
Klawf: Anger Shell boosts its stats when it drops below half HP. Rock Blast and High Horsepower; a decent bruiser.
Vikavolt: Levitate plus very high Special Attack. Thunderbolt and Bug Buzz, and Sticky Web for speed control.
Runerigus: Wandering Spirit swaps abilities with contact attackers. Ground/Ghost typing that covers different foes from Rhyperior.
Mabosstiff: Intimidate on entry, resists Ghost and Dark and is immune to Psychic; Jaw Lock traps its target. The piece that gives your team a Ghost and Psychic answer.
Crobat: Very fast Poison/Flying. With Tailwind from the relearner, it becomes a doubles speed-control lead that doubles your side's Speed.
Cursola: Very high Special Attack with Shadow Ball and Power Gem, and Strength Sap to heal. Fragile physically.
Ampharos (Aevian Form): Filter softens super-effective hits; Icy Wind and Frost Breath give speed control and crits. Better once its crest comes later.
Seismitoad: Water Absorb, Muddy Water spread damage and Drain Punch. Steady, but nothing it does stands out.
Florges: Huge Special Defence and Moonblast. Wish support for partners; not much damage elsewhere.
Sylveon: Pixilate turns Normal moves into strong Fairy ones. Its best spread move needs a later tutor.
Kilowattrel: Fast Electric/Flying pivot with Volt Switch and Roost. Light damage.
Electivire: Motor Drive absorbs Electric attacks for Speed. Mixed coverage but outclassed by your Fighting types.
Glaceon: Icy Wind slows both foes, and Freeze-Dry and Blizzard are your answer to Groudon and Dragons. Scores low alone but fills the six's Ice gap.
Revavroom: Filter Steel/Poison with Shift Gear. Can boost and hit, but slow to get going.
Porygon-Z: Adaptability Tri Attack after a Nasty Plot is the classic Showdown sweep, with Shadow Ball and Discharge for coverage. Frail, so set up behind Protect or Rage Powder.
Chandelure: Huge Special Attack with Shadow Ball and Fire. Mega stone owned for Chapter 12.
Drapion (Aevian Form): Fur Coat doubles its Defence; Ice/Poison with Gunk Shot and Icicle Crash. Physical wall that hits back.
Meowstic: Fake Out support for doubles and Psychic damage. Mega stone owned for Chapter 12.
Toxicroak: Dry Skin absorbs Water; Sucker Punch priority. Niche Poison/Fighting.
Palossand (Icy Aevian Form): Ghost/Ice with Bulletproof and Freeze-Dry. Bulky but low damage this chapter.
Espeon: Magic Bounce reflects status moves; Helping Hand support. Fast but light damage.
Tentacruel: Clear Body and huge Special Defence; Sludge Wave hits both foes. Mostly a utility mon.
Froslass (Aevian Form): Adaptability Grass/Water. Forum-rated, but its best moves (Water Spout, Muddy Water) aren't available yet.
Leavanny (Aevian Form): The setup partner. Rage Powder pulls attacks so Golisopod can Swords Dance, Intimidate weakens physical foes, and Focus Sash keeps it alive that turn.
Tangrowth: Regenerator, Sleep Powder and Rage Powder support. Bulky but low damage.
Noivern: Very fast Flying/Dragon with Air Slash and Dragon Pulse, but its hits are light.
Klinklang: Shift Gear setup with Gear Grind, but one attack type isn't enough this chapter.
Lucario: Fighting/Steel with Aura Sphere and Meteor Mash. Decent coverage, low bulk.
Zoroark: Illusion tricks the AI, but its damage is low until its Chapter 8 crest.
Meowscarada: Your starter, kept by choice. Protean and an always-crit Flower Trick make it fast and fun, but it's frail against these bosses.
Amoonguss: Regenerator, Rage Powder and Spore-style support. Very little damage.
Mismagius (Aevian Form): Magic Bounce Grass/Ghost. Support utility, low damage.
Alakazam: Very fast with huge Special Attack, but it only knows Teleport. Needs a real moveset before it's useful.
Furret: Its crest gives a free Substitute on entry for Baton Pass tricks. Not a fighter.
Electrode (Hisuian Form): Forum-rated for breaking the midgame, but only with its Chapter 8 crest.
Talonflame: Gale Wings priority Flying moves, but too frail and weak for these bosses.
Braviary: Brave Bird and Superpower on a sturdy Flying body, plus Tailwind for doubles speed control.
Golurk: Iron Fist Golurk: boosted Shadow Punch and Hammer Arm plus High Horsepower. Ground/Ghost, so it's immune to Normal, Fighting and Electric.
Clawitzer: Mega Launcher makes Water Pulse, Aura Sphere and Dark Pulse hit 50% harder. A strong special attacker with wide coverage.
Wyrdeer: Intimidate support with strong Double-Edge and Psyshield Bash. A bulky Normal/Psychic.
Scrafty: Fake Out, then Moxie snowballing with High Jump Kick and Crunch. A doubles staple.
Slowking (Galarian Form): Regenerator tank with Slack Off, and the only Trick Room setter you have right now.
Palossand: Ghost/Ground special attacker. Water Compaction punishes Water hits with +2 Defence.
Exeggutor: Grass/Psychic special attacker. Chlorophyll doubles its Speed in sun, so it's your Groudon specialist.
